description: BNR's reference rates as series, the exact text BNR published. With date (default today): each currency's rate in force that day, from the day's fixing or the last banking day's before it. With from (and to, default today): every fixing BNR published in the window, oldest first, at most 366 days and 2000 rates a call. Without currencies, every currency BNR published. Each series carries its multiplier (RON per 1, or per 100 for HUF, JPY, KRW and a few others).

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes, e.g. ["EUR", "USD"]; default every currency BNR published.

items.description: ISO 4217 code: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, ... (XAU gold, XDR SDR); case ignored.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD in Bucharest: the rates in force on it. Not with from.

from.description: A window's first day, YYYY-MM-DD: every fixing from it to `to`.

to.description: A window's last day, included; default today. Only with from.

name: rates

absent.description: Currencies asked for that BNR published no fixing of in the window

count.description: How many rates the series hold

date.description: The day asked for: each series holds the rate in force on it

series.description: One per currency, or per currency and multiplier if BNR changed it within the window

rate.description: BNR's exact text, RON per `multiplier` units

title: BNR rates: several currencies, or a window
